epistemic_status: CAPACITY BOUNDS, never a revenue projection. Every figure is an upper bound under the assumptions named beside it. Derived from M21's measured depth and D151's measured frequency; no new market measurement is made here.
why_this_node_was_unparked: M22 was parked as requiring live multi-book tape 'a clean checkout cannot supply'. That premise was a consequence of D138 - the tape existed and the worktree could not see it. D146 fixed the access, so the node became runnable.

observed_scale.note: the ceiling on every class below; WNBA is a small league with a short season

TRUE_CROSS_BOOK_ARBITRAGE.bounded_by: frequency x size x depth, all small, and they multiply

measured_depth_usdc.source: M21, real resting orders on the exchange

TRUE_CROSS_BOOK_ARBITRAGE.verdict: NOT A BUSINESS. Worth scanning only because the scanner already exists.

PURE_MICROSTRUCTURE_line_shopping.bounded_by: your own turnover; the market imposes no cap
PURE_MICROSTRUCTURE_line_shopping.verdict: A DISCOUNT, NOT INCOME. It stops a fixed percentage of your own money leaking. Bet nothing and it is worth nothing.

PROMOTIONAL_VALUE.bounded_by: the offer's own posted cap, by construction
PROMOTIONAL_VALUE.frequency: NOT MEASURED -- this programme has never observed a real offer
PROMOTIONAL_VALUE.verdict: Largest per-unit value in the report by two orders of magnitude, and it recurs on the venue's schedule rather than the market's. But the frequency is unknown, so no annualised figure is offered.

MIDDLES_AND_DISLOCATIONS.verdict: D152 measured most as negative expectation. Capacity for a losing bet is moot.

MODEL_VS_MARKET_VALUE.verdict: D141 and D150 measured no edge on any slice tested.

ranking_by_upper_bound: 1. PROMOTIONAL_VALUE -- largest per unit, recurring, frequency unmeasured
2. line shopping -- ~1.28% of your own turnover, certain and mechanical
headline: THE TWO CLASSES WORTH ANYTHING REQUIRE NO FORECASTING ABILITY WHATSOEVER. The one this programme spent ~58 screens building toward is last.

sensitivity.sportsbook_limits: UNMEASURED. M21 marked them ABSENT after checking the schema and grepping the codebase. Exchange depth is the only measured proxy. If book limits are far larger, arbitrage capacity rises - but a frequency of one per 41 days still caps it near nothing.
sensitivity.arb_rate_grid: 0.270% was measured on a mostly hourly grid and D151 records it as a LOWER bound. A faster grid should find more; today's cadence change is what will test it.
sensitivity.season: 3.0 games/day is in-season. Out of season every class goes to zero.
sensitivity.promo_frequency: The largest class is also the least measured.
sensitivity.vig_reduction: Measured over 2,591 markets. The most solid number in the report.

not_established: No realised-profit projection is made and none may be derived from this report.
Sportsbook maximum stakes remain ABSENT, not estimated. Determining them requires the venues' own rules, which is USER_REQUIRED, not a measurement.
Execution feasibility is untouched; EXECUTION_FEASIBLE needs measured decision-to-fill latency this node does not supply.
Nothing here authorises a stake, a venue, or a transition above SHADOW.
